mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and spironolactone may inhibit this enzyme; both drugs can cause anticholinergic effects and electrolyte abnormalities, with additive anticholinergic activity increasing adverse effects.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic side effects (dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention) and electrolyte levels (potassium, sodium); consider dose adjustment or alternative if excessive anticholinergic effects occur.
